node.statement: The constants selected in 1.1 have the required universal ranges. Because the receiving W, algebra, delta, U_0,U_1 and q fixed in 1.2 were arbitrary under the root hypotheses, 1.3 proves both binder-free path conclusions, 1.4-1.5 identify and type the exact displayed polar inverse along the whole path, and 1.6-1.8 prove joint continuity, the endpoint identities, and U(1)-equivariance. Universally generalizing these conclusions and existentially generalizing the constants proves the root contract.
